nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes local development artifacts (caches, venvs, session secrets, tests) from the Docker build context to keep the image lean and avoid leaking credentials.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Defines the copilot-api service with port mapping, environment variables for rate limiting (RATE_LIMIT_RPM, RATE_LIMIT_BURST), and a bind-mounted session volume for persistent browser profile storage.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker image based on Playwright Python that installs dependencies, copies the application, and serves the Copilot API on port 8000.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the official mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/python base image which ships Chromium preinstalled for headless browser automation.

nodes.name: python
nodes.summary: Build stage from the Playwright Python image that installs requirements, copies all source code, and runs app.py as the container entry point.
